title: CLMS Lake Water Quality (LWQ) NRT Global 300m 10-daily V2 (COG)
description: Provides semi-continuous observations for a large number of medium and large-sized lakes. 10-daily observations are available in near real time at 300 m spatial resolution from September 2024 to present, derived from Sentinel-3 OLCI.
